**Findings for `discovery.3.retry`**

- **Context bloat (turns 3–143).** The session read about 140 turns of rules, specs and code before its first edit, which used 247,599 tokens. Context peaked at 353k and stayed over 200k for 182 turns. This is a retry with `prior_overlap` 1.0, so the attempt re-derived what the previous attempt had already established. The retry carried no compact summary of what to fix, which is likely why the exploration was so wide.
- **Tool thrash (turns 105–110, 41–46).** The same long-line grep was run on one file with thresholds of 300, 800, 1200, 1600, 150 and 500. Other length greps (turns 41–46) were repeated across files one at a time. A single targeted search would have done the job.
- **Tool thrash (turns 143–167, 173–175, 178–190, 212–233).** The edits were split into one sentence per call. There were 16 edits on one file in a row, then 3 more, and the hand-off was edited about 9 times. Batching or rewriting the block would have been cheaper.
- **Wasted turns (turns 256–280).** The session did a lot of polish after the blocker was already addressed. It reworded `RGN-AC16`, shortened `RGF-AC3` even though it noted that criteria have no length limit, and ran several flagged-phrase sweeps. It also re-read the whole hand-off twice (turns 236, 240).
- **Ambiguity in the retry brief (turns 2, 281).** The retry context names only `ts-dis-general` as a blocker. The session treated two checks as flagged and also reworked `ts-dis-behaviour` (`RGN-B13`, `RGN-AC13`). The retry brief may be incomplete or inconsistent. The intent also contains an unfilled placeholder (`⟨missing:settings.conversation⟩`), which suggests a settings problem.

**Conformance:** The header lists no prompt sections, lessons, skills or subagent types, so there is nothing to grade. The session did open all six rule files first (turns 3–8), as its own plan intended.

```json
{"observations": [
{"category": "context_bloat", "turns": [3, 143], "remedy_class": "flow", "confidence": 0.6,
 "note": "The retry spent about 247k tokens reading before its first edit and stayed over 200k context for 182 turns, re-deriving what the earlier attempt already knew."},
{"category": "tool_thrash", "turns": [105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 110], "remedy_class": "prompt", "confidence": 0.5,
 "note": "The same long-line grep was run on one file with six different length thresholds; one query would have been enough."},
{"category": "tool_thrash", "turns": [143, 167, 173, 175, 178, 190, 212, 233], "remedy_class": "prompt", "confidence": 0.45,
 "note": "Many single-sentence edits were made to the same files in long runs instead of batching or rewriting the block."},
{"category": "wasted_turns", "turns": [236, 240, 256, 257, 266, 267, 277, 278, 279], "remedy_class": "flow", "confidence": 0.4,
 "note": "After the blockers were fixed the session kept polishing wording, re-reading the hand-off and sweeping for flagged phrases that gate would catch anyway."},
{"category": "request_ambiguous", "turns": [2, 281], "remedy_class": "flow", "confidence": 0.3,
 "note": "The retry context names only ts-dis-general, yet the session worked on two flagged checks, and the intent has an unfilled conversation placeholder."}
], "conformance": [], "none_found": false}
```
